title: Sam Altman's Countersuit Against His Sister Gets Green Light - Business Insider
summary: A federal judge dismissed a lawsuit alleging sexual abuse by OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, but allowed for refiling under Missouri's extended statute of limitations. Sam Altman countersued for defamation and abuse of the legal process.
sentiment_reason: The sentiment is negative due to the lawsuit dismissal and the countersuit alleging defamation and abuse of the legal process.
